name: App install

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Import every dependency

        run: node smoke.mjs

      - name: Let sensor settle
        if: always()

name: App install

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@39370e3970a6d050c480ffad4ff0ed4d3fdee5af # v4.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - uses: garnet-org/action@245ad6be82de3200c205109c8ca7ac816dc692ea # v2.3.0

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Import every dependency
        working-directory: app
        run: node smoke.mjs

      - name: Let sensor settle
        if: always()
        run: sleep 30

name: App install

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@39370e3970a6d050c480ffad4ff0ed4d3fdee5af # v4.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - uses: garnet-org/action@245ad6be82de3200c205109c8ca7ac816dc692ea # v2.3.0

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Import every dependency
        working-directory: app
        run: node smoke.mjs

      - name: Let sensor settle
        if: always()
        run: sleep 30

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:

    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)

name: App install

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

        with:

      - uses: garnet-org/action@245ad6be82de3200c205109c8ca7ac816dc692ea # v2.3.0

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Import every dependency
        working-directory: app
        run: node smoke.mjs

      - name: Let sensor settle
        if: always()

name: App install

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Import every dependency

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:

    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Import every dependency
        working-directory: app
        run: node smoke.mjs

        if: always()

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:

    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app

name: App install

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@39370e3970a6d050c480ffad4ff0ed4d3fdee5af # v4.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - uses: garnet-org/action@245ad6be82de3200c205109c8ca7ac816dc692ea # v2.3.0

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Import every dependency
        working-directory: app
        run: node smoke.mjs

      - name: Let sensor settle
        if: always()
        run: sleep 30

name: App install

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@39370e3970a6d050c480ffad4ff0ed4d3fdee5af # v4.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - uses: garnet-org/action@245ad6be82de3200c205109c8ca7ac816dc692ea # v2.3.0

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Import every dependency
        working-directory: app
        run: node smoke.mjs

      - name: Let sensor settle
        if: always()
        run: sleep 30

name: App install

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app/**"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-install-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install and import
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - uses: garnet-org/action@245ad6be82de3200c205109c8ca7ac816dc692ea # v2.3.0

      - name: Install dependencies (lifecycle scripts execute here)
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Import every dependency

        run: node smoke.mjs

      - name: Let sensor settle
        if: always()
        run: sleep 30

        if: always()
